messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: detected sustained spike in tool/function invocation volume. Elevated CPU and disk IO on inference nodes; structured-output endpoint (/v1/structured) error rate up. Auto-playbook triggered: apply invocation curfew for low-tier plans + degrade structured output to plaintext for high-throughput tenants. Paging oncall: @alex_oncall please ack and start mitigations.

alex_oncall: ack. seeing p99 token latency jump and ~12% 5xx on /v1/call-function. Will start curfew for 'free' and 'trial' plans and apply structured-output fallback for noisy tenants.

jamie_sre: patch ready for routing rule. Running dry-run then apply if looks sane. command I plan to run:```
redwoodctl routing set-invoke-curfew --plans free,trial --duration 30m --reason "runtime overload"
```

alex_oncall: running now. applying curfew.

status-bot: redwoodctl: routing update accepted (op-78654). Curfew active for plans: free, trial. Expires: +30m.

alex_oncall: curfew applied. immediate drop in invocation rate from sampled tenants. 5xxs trending down but still elevated for a handful of high-throughput paid tenants.

ravi_infra: for the heavy paid tenants I recommend toggling structured-output -> plaintext to reduce serialization CPU and KV cache pressure. Sample command:```
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --tenant acme-corp --feature structured_output --value plaintext --note "emergency degrade"
```

laura_prod: heads-up: ACME is live with a nightly job — switching to plaintext will change response shape. We should message CS and fallback logic owners and warn customers.

tess_support: opening CS tickets for the two customers seeing malformed JSON and for ACME to pre-announce. I will post an update to status page shortly.

jamie_sre: applying structured-output fallback to the top 5 noisy tenants (acme-corp, beta-inc, dataflowlabs, quickquery, testorg). Running small canary then fanout.```
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --selector noisy-tenants --feature structured_output --value plaintext --duration 60m
```

status-bot: feature-toggle op-78655 started. Canary on acme-corp succeeded (no immediate failures).

maria_ops: I'm taking the handoff in 20m. @alex_oncall please add short runbook lines about metrics to watch and rollback steps.

alex_oncall: notes: watch p50/p95 token latency, 5xx rate on /v1/structured and /v1/call-function, pod cpu and iowait. rollback: `redwoodctl routing clear-invoke-curfew --op op-78654` and `redwoodctl feature-toggle clear --op op-78655`.

laura_prod: also add customer comm text (short): "We're reducing structured responses temporarily to plaintext to stabilize performance. No data loss expected; returning to normal when load subsides."

alex_oncall: leaving thread for handoff. will monitor for 10m then hand to @maria_ops.

maria_ops: ack, taking over monitoring and customer comms. will escalate to infra if p99 stays >2s after 30m.

status-bot: status update posted to status.redwood.ai: "Mitigation active: invocation curfew for free/trial; structured output degraded for noisy tenants. Working on normalization."

alex_oncall: thanks team. I'll follow up with a post-incident note after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
